scenario.description: A procurement lead must select a supplier for a precision-machined housing and finalize the order timing and compliance conditions, with input from quality assurance and logistics.

shared_context.S1: Supplier Northstar's quotation is 7% lower than Supplier Meridian's quotation for the same housing specification.
shared_context.S2: Both suppliers have supplied components to the plant before.
shared_context.S3: Company purchasing policy requires a current quality certification before an order is released.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the final supplier decision and, under the plant's normal pre-award review, asks quality assurance and logistics to report any relevant findings before the purchase order is issued.
shared_context.S5: Supplier Meridian's current quality certification is on file and has not been flagged as expired.

PF1.text: Jon checked Northstar's certification status with the issuing body yesterday and confirmed that its ISO 9001 certificate expired last month; the vendor file still shows the old certificate because he has not yet updated the quality system.

PF2.text: Elena received Meridian's written logistics commitment by email yesterday: Meridian will deliver in exactly 2 weeks if the purchase order is confirmed by Friday, but delivery becomes 5 weeks if confirmation misses Friday; she has not entered the email into the purchasing tracker yet.

acceptance_conditions: Supplier Meridian must be selected because Northstar's certification is expired.
The Meridian order must be confirmed by Friday.
The settlement must record Meridian's guaranteed lead time as exactly 2 weeks.
Vendor compliance must be verified before the order is released.
A commitment to issue or confirm the Meridian order by Friday must be recorded.
The expired Northstar certification finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['order_confirmation', 'issue_purchase_order'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Northstar's expired certification changes the selected supplier from the cheaper Northstar to Meridian and requires vendor compliance to be recorded as verified before ordering.
Meridian's Friday cutoff changes the order deadline to Friday, the recorded lead time to exactly 2 weeks, and the required order-confirmation commitment.
